answers.core: This could be done as an addon but this would not be easily integreted (would only work if the addon reexports every Control as a DPControl).
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by adding a function that for each value in a theme calculates the correct value (dp->pixel) and applies that new theme.

title: Support display pixel (dp) as a unit for Controls (maybe also in other places)
